title: Molly and the Truck with All the Drawers
synopsis: When Farmer Ruth's red tractor will not start, Ms. Pam brings a white mobile service truck with tools, tests the battery and gets the farm ready for tomorrow.
continuity_state: Before: The hay harvest is complete and bales are dry in the red barn. Farmer Ruth's red tractor normally works, but one morning it will not start. Ms. Pam is a known mechanic, and her garage is west on Brook Road. After: Ms. Pam's white mobile service truck, with side compartments and diagnostic equipment, becomes an established garage vehicle. Pam checks Farmer Ruth's tractor, finds its old battery no longer holds a reliable charge, replaces it, and takes the old battery away for recycling. The red tractor works again and remains at the farm; harvested hay stays in the barn.
